subject: Discovery follow-up & pilot charter proposal — Olive Diagnostics
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@olivedx.com>, Oliver Park <oliver.park@olivedx.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery follow-up & pilot charter proposal — Olive Diagnostics

Hi Emily / Oliver — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call and a proposal for a 3-week pilot to validate fit: we captured three core pain points and proposed success metrics below.

Pain points we heard
- Production latency spikes on near-real-time triage (current p50 ~600ms under load)
- Per-request cost and unpredictable token billing when models are batched inefficiently
- Data governance: need for private network options and audit logs for PHI-adjacent records

Primary goals for the pilot
- Reduce median inference latency for the triage flow to <=250ms (p50) at expected concurrency
- Demonstrate consistent unit economics: target per-1000-token cost below your current baseline by >=20%
- Validate output quality on your >=600-row prompt set with an initial target F1 > 0.82 on the labeled cases

Proposed pilot scope (3 weeks)
- Week 0 (kickoff & access): environment provisioning, API key exchange, sanitized sample dataset ingestion
- Week 1: integration & baseline runs (current model and Redwood default config)
- Week 2: tuning (batching, quantization profile, caching) and prompt-eval runs
- Week 3: final runs, handover, and metrics review; decision gate (go/no-go)

Owners
- Olive Diagnostics: Emily Chen (Product Owner), Oliver Park (Security/Procurement)
- Redwood: Rachel Kim (AE, engagement lead), Ben Carter (CSM), Rishi Malhotra (Solutions lead)

Access we need to start
- Sanitized sample dataset (S3 link or secure Drive) — min 500 labeled examples
- A sandbox API key or temporary account to run inference against your triage endpoint
- Contact for security questionnaire (SOC2 evidence, app architecture diagram)

Initial success metrics (for pilot evaluation)
- Performance: p50/p95 latency, throughput at target concurrency, CPU/GPU utilization
- Cost: per-1k-token effective cost after batching/caching adjustments
- Quality: prompt-set accuracy/F1 and hand-curated failure-rate on high-impact cases

Attachments: POC-Checklist.xlsx (kickoff checklist), prompt-set-v1.csv (sample prompts) — both attached for your review.

Proposed kickoff: Wed Mar 17, 10:00–11:00 PT. If that works, we’ll send a calendar invite and the kickoff charter doc (Drive link).

Next steps
1) Emily/Oliver: confirm kickoff time and who will own the sanitized sample delivery
2) Olive security: provide security contact and any baseline compliance docs you can share
3) Redwood: schedule kickoff invite, share SOW draft and access checklist

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

—
Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
https://redwoodinference.com
From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@olivedx.com>

Thanks Rachel — appreciate the clear summary. Quick notes from our side:

- Confirmed pain points and goals — those line up with what Emily and I discussed offline.
- Timeline: 3-week window looks fine but can we shift kickoff to Thu Mar 18 instead of Wed Mar 17? We have an all-hands on the 17th.
- Data: we can provide a sanitized sample (sanitized at row/PHI level) by Fri Mar 12. Security will intake the questionnaire after that.
- Security contact: please add security@olivedx.com to future threads — Oliver will loop in the SOC2 reviewer there.

Action items from Olive
1) Deliver sanitized sample by 2027-03-12 (Emily)
2) Procurement: I’ll share a PO request to get the SOW process started — cc: Oliver for procurement/security follow-up

Kickoff proposed: Thu Mar 18, 10:00–11:00 PT (preferred). If that works we’ll lock it.

Emily
Product Manager, Olive Diagnostics

- Baseline run plan (what metrics we’ll capture, instrumentation)
- Suggested quantization profile(s) and trade-offs for their triage workload (latency vs quality)
- Quick eval harness for the provided prompt-set-v1.csv (automated scoring + manual spot checks)
- Approx resource estimate (GPU hours) and cost delta for the 3-week pilot

Rachel — I’ll coordinate the kickoff logistics and own the onboarding checklist execution.
